The document doesn't contain this number. MMMU-Pro is listed as one of the multimodal reasoning benchmarks (p. 14; also Appendix A, p. 33). The text refers to the results tables, such as "results_flagship," but those multimodal benchmark tables aren't included in this version. So no MMMU-Pro score is given for GPT-5 (high) or any other model.

The only GPT-5 "high" result in the text is on MIA-Bench. There, Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking beats GPT-5-high-thinking by 10.0 points on the *math* subtask and 5.0 points on the *textual* subtask (p. 14). The absolute scores aren't stated.

The original arXiv paper (2511.21631) has the full results tables if you need the number.
